g.text: Share of employment in clerical jobs

g.aria-label: Title text 'Clerical jobs, the work most exposed to generative AI, are concentrated in high-income countries'
g.text: Clerical jobs, the work most exposed to generative AI, are concentrated in high-income countries

g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Share of employment in clerical support occupations (ISCO-08 group 4), latest year available (2010–2025). Exposed = a large share of the job's tasks could potentially be done by generative AI (ILO, 2025); exposure is not the same as job loss. Gray = no occupation data reported to the ILO, including large economies such as China and Canada.'

text.tspan: Share of employment in clerical support occupations (ISCO-08 group 4), latest year available (2010–2025).
Exposed = a large share of the job's tasks could potentially be done by generative AI (ILO, 2025); exposure is not the same as job loss.
Gray = no occupation data reported to the ILO, including large economies such as China and Canada.
